activity.authority: Optional host operation/current_batch/last_request/final termination_reason only. No fabricated token progress or percentage.
activity.main_display: One activity line; waiting/receiving/tool/retry based on actual operation receipt. Technical start/attempt/tool/error details stay inside Notes.
activity.elapsed: Recorded host elapsed_ms plus local elapsed since the successful exact-run detail receipt while fresh/live. SSE keepalive never refreshes observation.
activity.freshness: Disconnected live stream or no successful detail observation for over 30 seconds (three existing ten-second polling intervals) displays recent snapshot and freezes local operation elapsed; this is an observation threshold, not a provider timeout/cancel/retry policy.
activity.legacy: No operation receipt means activity unrecorded with latest event time, not assumed model work.
activity.batches: Current N only with explicit current_batch_index during extracting; completed/failed batch totals are separate observed facts. Reconciling/terminal states hide current index.
activity.terminal_priority: Cancelled/failed/interrupted override leftover operation receipts, stop local timers/indeterminate state and clearly show stopped. Other ended incomplete runs clearly say ended.
activity.quota_reason: Only known final host reason on ready partial/failed shows 已停止：调用额度不足，已保留结果. Known time limits use separate truthful time-limit text. Unknown reason or a single provider request failure does not imply quota/provider stop.
